findings.text: You stay steady after losses. Your results don't change.
From your 3rd trade of the day, you lose money.
findings.action: Set a limit of 2 trades per day.

findings.text: Monday is your most expensive day: 46% of your losses.
findings.action: Cut size by half on Monday until the pattern changes.

findings.text: The London/New York overlap session cost you 42% of your losses. Without it, your profit factor would be 0.80.
findings.action: Trade only the sessions where your record is positive for the next month, then compare.

findings.segment: 15:00–18:00 broker server time (close to Beirut time)
findings.text: Trades opened between 15:00–18:00 broker server time (close to Beirut time) lost money overall.
findings.action: Block those hours in your plan and review after 30 trades.

findings.text: Your long trades lose money overall.
findings.action: Review your last 10 long trades: what did they have in common?

findings.text: GBPJPY produced 35% of your losses. Without it, your profit factor would be 0.71.
findings.action: Pause GBPJPY or trade it at half size until you understand why it costs you.

findings.text: After a big win, you trade 1.1× bigger and give back 89% of it.
findings.action: Keep the same size for the 5 trades after any big win.

findings.text: Your risk per trade swings from 0.5% to 2.4%.
findings.action: Fix one risk percentage per trade and size every position from it.
